proceeding: Electronic Application of Kentucky Utilities Company for an Adjustment of its Electric Rates, and Approval of Certain Regulatory and Accounting Treatments
how_obtained: Downloaded the PDF with curl from the Kentucky PSC public electronic case filing path (psc.ky.gov/pscecf/...), which serves case documents without a login. Extracted text with PyMuPDF using sorted-block extraction (page.get_text('text', sort=True)) so the margin line numbers stay on the same line as the testimony text they number. Pages are joined with a form feed (\x0c). No cleaning, reflow, de-hyphenation or whitespace normalisation was applied; the spacing, running heads and word-spacing artefacts are exactly what the extractor produced.
document_title: Direct Testimony of Lisa V. Perry on Behalf of Walmart Inc. (Errata - Clean)
filer: Walmart Inc. (counsel: Spilman Thomas & Battle, PLLC)
notes: Testimony only, no exhibits. Differs from the 2025-08-29 original at page 20, line 14: 'intraclass' becomes 'interclass'. The change reflows lines 14-18 of that page.
